summary: The Azure Big Data Engineer designs and maintains large-scale big data solutions on Microsoft Azure for analytics and machine learning workloads.
responsibilities: Develop and manage data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics,
Integrate Azure storage and compute services for big data workflows
Optimize pipelines for performance and cost efficiency
Ensure security and compliance of data assets
Collaborate with analytics and AI/ML teams

education: 3–6 years of Azure big data experience

skills_required.name: Experience with Azure services (Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, Data Lake
Programming in Python, Scala, or SQL
Strong knowledge of distributed data processing
Familiarity with monitoring and alerting tools
